caffeine_ergogenic.guidance: Slow metaboliser — high-dose pre-workout caffeine likely impairs rather than enhances endurance and elevates BP. Stick to ≤1 mg/kg if any; consider beta-alanine, beetroot juice, or no stimulant.

chronotype.rationale: Late-chronotype genotype — peak strength, power, and reaction-time performance shifts later in the day. Avoid 06:00 sessions if performance matters; reserve early hours for low-intensity work.

cognitive.summary: BDNF Val/Val — efficient activity-dependent BDNF secretion. Strong cognitive-benefit response to aerobic exercise.
cognitive.training_note: Conventional aerobic training (3-4 ×/week, 40-60 min Zone 2) is highly effective for mood, memory, and neuroplasticity outcomes.

composite_profile.summary: Composite athletic index: 51.4/100. Top-matched sport: Sprinting (100-400m) (fit 85.5). Strongest attribute: power (100). Weakest: endurance (0).

concurrent_training.rule: Separate strength and endurance by ≥6 h on same day, or alternate days. Keep weekly endurance ≤ 90 min total when in a strength block.

daily_readiness.formula: Daily readiness (0-100) = 0.30·HRV_norm + 0.25·Sleep_norm + 0.15·RestingHR_norm + 0.15·SubjectiveEnergy + 0.10·Soreness_inverse + 0.05·Mood. Each component normalised vs your 14-day rolling baseline.
daily_readiness.personal_note: Slow-recovery genotype — be MORE conservative with thresholds. Push red to 55, treat 50-64 as orange.

thresholds.action: Green — push hard. PRs encouraged. Heavy day or VO2max.
Yellow — normal session, hold RPE ≤8. Skip max efforts.
Orange — reduce volume 30%. Easy aerobic or technique work only.
Red — full rest or 20 min walk. Forcing it now buys nothing.

daily_readiness.tracking: Daily HRV (rMSSD on waking via Whoop/Oura/HRV4Training), resting HR, subjective 1-5 sliders for energy/soreness/mood. Take a 14-day baseline before computing deviations. 3 consecutive days <baseline = mandatory deload.

deload.frequency: Every 4-6 weeks (slow recovery: every 4; fast: every 6).
structure: Volume −50% (cut sets in half, keep load).
Intensity −20% on top sets (RPE 6-7 instead of 8-9).
Cut highest-impact work (sprints, plyo, max-effort lifts) first.
Sleep extension +30 min; emphasise pre-bed nutrition (40 g protein + carbs).
Mobility/aerobic flush 2-3 sessions; full rest 1-2 days.
deload.trigger_signals: If you see: HRV ↓ >7% for 3+ days, RPE drift (same load feels harder), sleep quality dropping, joint pain accumulating, plateau in PRs ≥ 2 weeks → deload immediately, don't wait for the scheduled one.

fat_loss.guidance: FTO obesity-risk allele — GOOD NEWS: large studies show ≥150 min/week of moderate aerobic exercise NEUTRALISES the FTO weight-gain effect. Aerobic exercise is non-negotiable. Strength training adds compounding benefit by raising RMR. Combine with high-protein/high-fibre eating for best fat-loss outcomes.

hr_zones.polarised: 80/20 rule: 80% of weekly training in Z1–Z2, 20% in Z3–Z5. Avoid the 'grey zone' (Z3 every day) — neither builds base nor builds peak.

zones.use: Mitochondrial / fat oxidation — most weekly volume
3–5 min hard intervals — high-leverage capacity work

risks.mitigation: Favourable tendon-stiffness profile — running economy advantage.

regions.interventions: Vitamin D >40 ng/mL, calcium 1000 mg, heavy strength 2×/wk, mileage <10%/wk increase.
Nordic curls 2×/wk, single-leg RDLs, hop-stick drills, FMS screening.
Band external rotations, face pulls 100/week, scapular control, avoid kipping pullups early.
McGill big-3 daily (curl-up, side bridge, bird-dog), hip-hinge mastery before loading, no flexed-spine loading.
Spanish squats / decline squats 2×/wk, isometric wall sits, manage running volume jumps.
Daily heel drops (eccentric), slow gradual mileage build, calf raises 3×/wk.

iron_endurance.guidance: Endurance athletes with HFE variants have higher iron stores than peers — DO NOT supplement iron without lab confirmation. Annual ferritin + transferrin saturation check. Excess iron blunts mitochondrial function and increases oxidative damage in athletes.

strategies: Flexible stress-performance curve — both calm and aroused states work.

mobility.guidance: Mobility is a SKILL — daily small doses outperform weekly 30-min sessions. Pair to existing cues (post-shower, post-workout).

motivation.guidance: Typical dopaminergic reward — exercise habit usually forms within 6–8 weeks of consistency. Use that 'runner's high' window.

pain_tolerance.guidance: Typical pain perception — RPE scales reliably.

power_endurance.recommendation: Prioritise heavy strength (3-6 reps) and explosive work (jumps, sprints, Olympic lifts). 2-3 short conditioning sessions/week is sufficient. Avoid chronic high-volume aerobic which blunts your strength response.

ftp_test_protocols: Ramp test (Zwift/TrainerRoad): 1-min steps + 75% of final 1-min power

detraining_timeline.what_happens: Glycogen stores stay full; soreness clears. ZERO detraining.
Plasma volume drops 5-10%; HR rises 5-10 bpm at given pace. Strength UNCHANGED.
VO2max -4-6%. Strength still preserved (neural).  Hypertrophy maintained 2-3 weeks even without training.
VO2max -10%. Strength begins to drop. Re-introduce 2× lifting/wk to preserve.
Substantial detraining. VO2max -15-20%. Hypertrophy losses begin (but slow).
Detraining largely complete for endurance. Strength can hold longer (esp. with maintenance volume).
Myonuclei from prior hypertrophy persist 10+ years — return to previous size 2-3× faster than initial gains. Strength can return in 4-8 weeks vs months.

30min_time_trial_threshold.formula: Lactate threshold HR ≈ average HR over final 20 min of 30-min all-out time trial (Friel).
30min_time_trial_threshold.how_to: 30 min all-out solo TT on familiar route (running, rowing, or cycling). Wear HR monitor.

beep_test_multistage.how_to: 20 m shuttle runs, pace increases every minute. Continue to failure.

cooper_12min_run.how_to: Warm up 10 min. Run as far as possible in exactly 12 min on flat track.

rockport_1mile_walk.best_for: De-conditioned, older athletes, or anyone unable to run.
rockport_1mile_walk.how_to: Walk 1 mile (1.6 km) as briskly as possible. Record time + HR at finish.

two_km_row.formula: Erg score (time) → table for VO2max. World class men: <6:00 / women: <7:00.
two_km_row.how_to: All-out 2 km on Concept2. Damper 4-6, drag factor 120-130 men / 110-120 women.

ymca_step_test.formula: 3 min stepping on 12-in box at 24 steps/min; recovery HR for 1 min predicts VO2max.

hr_zone_demo_age_35.note: Karvonen (using HR reserve) is more individually accurate than flat %HRmax.

context_modifiers: Alcohol, illness, poor sleep all crash HRV — diagnose cause before reducing training.
Caffeine before measurement skews readings — measure fasted.
Hormonal cycle (female): HRV dips luteal phase — normal, not a red flag.
Travel + altitude crash HRV 24-72 h — give yourself a buffer.

decision_rules.action: Green light — schedule HARDEST session this cycle.
Yellow — reduce volume 25%, intensity cap RPE 7.
RED — mandatory full deload or rest week. Don't push through.

hrv_guided_week.implementation: Whoop, Oura, Garmin, HRV4Training, Elite HRV — all valid. Consistency matters more than device. Take 4 weeks to build baseline before acting on day-to-day deviations.
hrv_guided_week.tracking: AM HRV (rMSSD or proprietary) immediately on waking, daily. Track 14-day rolling mean and 7-day rolling mean. Daily reading interpreted relative to baseline.

sleep.guidance: Standard 7.5–9 h target. Sleep-extension protocol on hard training weeks: +30–60 min vs baseline. Track HRV trend; <baseline 3 days = mandatory deload.

strength_trainability.recommendation: Hypertrophy genes lean low — focus on strength (3–6 reps, heavy) where neural adaptations drive bigger early gains, plus high-volume blocks (8–12 weeks) for body composition. Consistency beats genes.

stress_fracture.guidance: Elevated stress-fracture risk markers — for runners/jumpers: ramp running mileage ≤10%/week, alternate impact days with cycling/swim, prioritise vitamin D ≥40 ng/mL, calcium 1000 mg/day, and bone-loading strength work (heavy squats, jumps) 2×/week — these strengthen bone more than running.

thermal_adaptation.cold_protocol: Cold exposure 2-3 min @ 50-59 °F (10-15 °C) 3-5×/wk pre-breakfast — increases brown-fat activity over 4-6 weeks (Søberg protocol: 11 min/wk minimum across multiple sessions). Avoid IMMEDIATELY post-strength training (blunts hypertrophy adaptation 12+ h).
thermal_adaptation.heat_protocol: Sauna 80-90 °C, 20-30 min, 3-4×/wk post-exercise — heat-shock protein induction, plasma volume +7%, cardiac output adaptation. Endurance performance improves ~7% in trained athletes after 10 sauna sessions (Scoon et al). Rehydrate 1.5× sweat lost.

training_nutrition.intra_workout: Strength sessions: water only is fine. >90 min lift: 20 g intra-EAAs or carbs optional.
training_nutrition.post_workout: Within 1–2 h: 0.3 g/kg protein (20–40 g) + carbs (1 g/kg if depleted). Examples: Greek yoghurt + berries + granola; chicken + rice + veg. Hydrate to 150% of fluid lost (weigh in/out).
